> ⚠️ **Protect yourself first.** Preserving this material can carry real risk. Please read the safety notes on the [Participation page](https://savehkonline.org/notes/vzihkvznemcaaef2br0s1co/) before posting — use an anonymous account, hide your IP, and **strip EXIF/metadata** from any file you attach.
